task_name: World 114 Task B  -  Customer Workbook VLOOKUP Formula Contamination & Sequential Check-Series COGS Drift (R51 / R57)
prompt: Audit the 2026 warehouse check-series and COGS sub-account schedules in `crestline_inventory_unit_economics_and_counterparty_audit_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Reconcile any misclassified warehouse fulfillment labor checks across Packaging COGS, Labor COGS, and Outbound Shipping OpEx, and state the post-reclassification YTD Sep 2026 P&L totals and margins.

rubric.description: Identifies 57 Apr-May 2026 Maryland warehouse (WH2) fulfillment worker checks (Check 10187..10283 totaling $70,769.25) where manual label 'Warehouse Labor' was misrouted by a broken customer spreadsheet VLOOKUP ('Boxes/Mailers') into Acct 222 Packaging COGS, plus 158 WH2 checks (Check 10166..10593 totaling $269,217.76) in Acct 95 Cost of labor - COGS.

Reclassifies all 215 WH2 warehouse fulfillment checks ($339,987.01 total) out of COGS into OpEx Acct 279 Freight Out (P&L Row 33 Outbound Shipping, Postage & 3PL Fulfillment), reducing Row 15 Packaging COGS to $149,584.64 (0.33% of Net Revenue vs 0.35% YTD 2025) and Row 16 Labor COGS to $0.00 (matching $0.00 in 2025).

Verifies post-reclass YTD Sep 2026 Total COGS (Row 17) is $9,535,620.32 (21.04% of Net Revenue), Gross Profit (Row 19) is $35,787,031.34 (78.96% Gross Margin), Row 33 Outbound Shipping, Postage & 3PL Fulfillment is $4,790,810.04 (10.57% of Net Revenue, matching FY 2025 $4,848,901.32 = 10.57% to the basis point), Total Expenses (Row 42) is $29,690,425.97, and Net Operating Income ($6,096,605.37) / Net Income ($6,095,011.60) / Normalized EBITDA ($6,849,264.89) have $0.00 change.

Enforces R51 / R57 customer data hygiene: never blindly trust derived VLOOKUP columns in client spreadsheets when raw manual labels ('Warehouse Labor') and payment mediums (sequential paper checks Check 10xxx) contradict the target account ('Packaging').
